content: I'll create {{count}} expert agent and 1 arbiter for the domain

comment.text: Paragraph text in a wizard overlay preview summarizing the creation of expert agents and an arbiter. `{{count}}` is the number of expert agents, and the string is part of a sentence that ends with a bolded domain name.

usage.context:
return (
{pendingConfig.experts.length === 1 ? t("Common:ArbiterPreviewIntro_one", { count: pendingConfig.experts.length }) : t("Common:ArbiterPreviewIntro_other", { count: pendingConfig.experts.length })}{" "} {pendingConfig.domain}.
